svg.title: How the skills hand off work
svg.desc: Three chains. A: spec-splitter splits the bound project manual into sections and text, and submittal-log-generator turns every Part 1 submittal item into the submittal log. B: bid-tabulator tabulates the bids as submitted, bid-evaluator checks them against the contract documents and recommends, the PE chooses the award at a hold point, and subcontract-writer drafts the subcontract from the firm's template. C: pe-review, submittal-review, tag-audit-and-takeoff, code-researcher, submittal-log-generator and spec-splitter log issues as they work; the PE picks which become RFIs, and rfi-drafter drafts each in the firm's RFI form. Every file is a draft; nothing is sent, signed or approved for the PE.
svg.text: HOW THE SKILLS HAND OFF WORK
Each chain ends in a file in your project folder. The skill stops at every hold point until you decide.
